claims.nodeLabel: TR-AC-47, Joint ATIC-WADC Report on Project Silver Bug, 15 February 1955
claims.sourceText: TR-AC-47, page 1, Section I B 1, General Description, https://documents.theblackvault.com/documents/SilverBug/AFD-070114-006.pdf
claims.text: Section I distinguishes the two company designations: 'Two versions of small research VTO aircraft have been designed by the contractor, which, by company designation, are Project Y (Secret), a "tail-sitter", and Project Y2 (Secret), a "flat-riser". Early in the investigation, Project Y (Secret) was rejected by the contractor in favor of the flat-riser.'

claims.nodeLabel: TR-AC-47, Joint ATIC-WADC Report on Project Silver Bug, 15 February 1955
claims.text: The Summary's Discussion section states: 'This project should in no way be associated with any science fiction or "Flying Saucer" stories because of its external appearance. The configuration was a result of an engineering investigation into the solution of a particular problem.' It names the contractor as 'AVRO Aircraft, Limited, a member of the Hawker-Siddley Group'.

claims.nodeLabel: TR-AC-47, Joint ATIC-WADC Report on Project Silver Bug, 15 February 1955
claims.text: The report names the Coanda effect but not Henri Coanda: Figure 15 is 'Coanda Effect: High Aspect Ratio Jet Bending' and page 17 describes 'the so-called "Coanda effect" whereby a jet stream is deflected through large angles by having a curved surface in contact with its edge at one side'. No individual designer is named anywhere in the pages read, and the string 'Frost' does not appear in them.

claims.nodeLabel: TR-AC-47, Joint ATIC-WADC Report on Project Silver Bug, 15 February 1955
claims.sourceText: TR-AC-47, page 23, Section II B, Present Development Status, https://documents.theblackvault.com/documents/SilverBug/AFD-070114-006.pdf
claims.text: Section II dates the USAF development track: Technical Requirement No. 3 dated 13 August 1954, a development plan dated 15 September 1954 written by 'WADC, Directorate of Weapons Systems Operations, Bombardment Aircraft Division, New Development Office', an order to proceed issued 29 December 1954, and a proposed statement of work dated 8 November 1954 to be incorporated in a study contract.

claims.nodeLabel: TR-AC-47, Joint ATIC-WADC Report on Project Silver Bug, 15 February 1955
claims.text: Table III, 'CONTRACTOR ESTIMATED PERFORMANCE, Radial-Flow Engine Aircraft', gives Mach 2.6 and a 71,600 ft ceiling without reheat and Mach 3.48 and an 80,600 ft ceiling with 1500 degrees K reheat. The report qualifies these on page 17: 'The performance estimated by the contractor was based on rather broad assumptions and has not as yet been investigated by a wind tunnel test program.'

claims.nodeLabel: TR-AC-47, Joint ATIC-WADC Report on Project Silver Bug, 15 February 1955
claims.sourceText: TR-AC-47 title page, rendered from the scan at https://documents.theblackvault.com/documents/SilverBug/AFD-070114-006.pdf
claims.text: The title page reads 'TR-AC-47 / (Unclassified) / JOINT ATIC-WADC REPORT ON / PROJECT SILVER BUG / PROJECT NO. 9961 / 15 FEBRUARY 1955', issued by the 'AIR TECHNICAL INTELLIGENCE CENTER, WRIGHT-PATTERSON AIR FORCE BASE, OHIO', and carries a handwritten declassification stamp reading 'Declassified 29 MAR 95', 'Auth: DoD 5200.1.R', 'SAF/AAZD'.

claims.nodeLabel: TR-AC-47, Joint ATIC-WADC Report on Project Silver Bug, 15 February 1955
claims.text: The report's Summary states its purpose: 'This report presents factual technical data on A. V. Roe, Canada, Limited, proposed development, Project Y2 (Secret)... The ultimate purpose of presenting this is two-fold; to correct the distorted picture presented in previous releases, both classified and unclassified, and to acquaint the intelligence community with the current state-of-the-art facts thereby alerting them to any air intelligence information which may become available indicating Soviet interest in this specialized field.'

edges.label: A dated Air Force document dismissing the flying-saucer resemblance of an aircraft it was itself funding
edges.note: The Summary states that the project 'should in no way be associated with any science fiction or "Flying Saucer" stories because of its external appearance', which is a denial with an author, a date and a subject, and is what this board's denial domain exists to hold.
